title: Waiver of the Restocking Charge for Members on a Field-Services Plan, Crop Input Purchasing Accounts
content:
A member who has the cooperative in their fields under Custom Application and Field Services carries a waiver against the restocking charge on a return credit written on their crop input account, and how much of the charge is waived follows how much work has been done for them.

**Clause.** Where the member holds a live field-services plan with the cooperative and three or more application passes have been completed for them over the 10 statement months before the handling date, the waived share of the restocking charge is 50 percent. Where the member holds a live field-services plan with the cooperative and fewer than three application passes have been completed for them over those months, the waived share is 25 percent. In every other case no share of the restocking charge is waived on the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts.

## The plan and the passes together

| A live field-services plan | Application passes completed over the 10 statement months | Waived share of the restocking charge |
| --- | --- | --- |
| held | 3 or more | 50 percent |
| held | fewer than 3 | 25 percent |
| not held | any | No share is waived |

The passes counted are the application passes the cooperative has completed for that member under Custom Application and Field Services inside the window, whatever the field or the product they were made on. A member with two completed passes stands in the lower band; a third completed pass inside the window carries them to the upper one. The waived share is a share of the restocking charge itself and of nothing else.
